notes: The italic *even* is marked added: rule 16 gives an appositional *even* only to a marker standing on the very phrase it introduces, and אִשֶּׁה carries none — the clause's markers stand on הַחֵלֶב and its coordinates, which the ASV renders bare. The italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
מִמֶּנּוּ is one fused *thereof* unit under rule 22, headed on the preposition, rather than a rendered preposition beside an unrepresented suffix.
